templates.title: Ambush
templates.opening: The hostile group attacks from concealment and immediately tests the party’s formation.

templates.title: Patrol Interception
templates.opening: A moving patrol spots the party and shifts into a fighting formation.

templates.title: Interrupted Rite
templates.opening: The party arrives as a hostile rite reaches a dangerous turning point.

templates.title: Predators on the Hunt
templates.opening: Tracks, broken foliage, and sudden silence reveal predators closing in.

templates.title: Boarding Action
templates.opening: Hostiles surge across a narrow approach where movement and forced positioning matter.

templates.title: Ruined Stronghold
templates.opening: The encounter begins among broken cover, unstable walls, and defensible choke points.

templates.title: Covenant Under Pressure
templates.opening: A divine edict, anathema, or shadow has turned an ordinary confrontation into a test of covenant and consequence.

templates.title: Bounty Ichor Pursuit
templates.opening: A deity-bound class is pursuing a meaningful bounty trigger, and the party has entered the decisive moment.

templates.title: Creator-Legacy Dispute
templates.opening: A conflict over lineage, created peoples, or a creator-category claim has become dangerous enough to draw weapons.

reactionRules.threatOnAttack: Hostiles add the attacker to their threat table even when an attack misses.
reactionRules.ichorCircuitParry: Qualifying humanoids may spend one charge, add +2 AC, and retaliate with lightning if the revised AC makes a metal melee attack miss.
reactionRules.eightAxisBehavior: Mercy, Transformation, Autonomy, and Restraint alter surrender, escalation, adaptation, independence, and impulse-control behavior without changing the 81-profile title.
reactionRules.covenantInfluence: Assigned covenant pressures modify up to three axes by 250 points; class discipline deepens up to two focus axes by 125 points for the generated encounter instance.

objectives.label: Rescue
objectives.progress: Reach and extract the endangered people
objectives.danger: Captives are moved, harmed, or separated

objectives.label: Escape
objectives.progress: Open and reach a viable escape route
objectives.danger: Routes close or pursuit gains ground

objectives.label: Hold
objectives.progress: Maintain the position until relief or completion
objectives.danger: The position, civilians, or critical system is overrun

objectives.label: Disable
objectives.progress: Disable the device, ritual, vehicle, or weapon
objectives.danger: The hostile system reaches full effect

objectives.label: Expose
objectives.progress: Reveal evidence, identity, or hidden mechanism
objectives.danger: Evidence is destroyed or witnesses are silenced

objectives.label: Steal
objectives.progress: Secure the target and create an exit
objectives.danger: The target is moved, locked down, or damaged

objectives.label: Seal
objectives.progress: Complete the seal before the breach stabilizes
objectives.danger: The breach expands or changes the scene

objectives.label: Negotiate
objectives.progress: Establish terms acceptable to the involved parties
objectives.danger: Trust collapses and violence becomes harder to stop

objectives.label: Survive
objectives.progress: Endure until the hazard passes or an opening appears
objectives.danger: Resources, cover, or safe ground are lost

objectives.label: Choose Between Costs
objectives.progress: Create enough leverage to choose rather than merely react

timeRules.clock: Earth UTC retained as world UTC
timeRules.encounterEffect: Local daypart changes schedules, available services, patrols, crowds, watch changes, nocturnal activity, and timezone-crossing complications.

covenantEngine.initiative: highest roll first, then alternate sides while possible
covenantEngine.strongEncounter: Use a non-HP objective, at least two meaningful terrain interactions, and a route that changes as a clock advances.
